title: Zephyr: Verify signed fields list per spec
notes: Completed signed-field transcript validation. Authoritative order is the 15-byte LICHEN-LINK-v1\0 domain || LENGTH || LLSec || EPO || SEQ(big-endian) || DST_LEN(non-wire) || DST || SIID(8) || payload; MIC is excluded. Extended the clean C cross-language interop consumer to reject per-field mutations of LENGTH, LLSec, epoch, sequence, DST_LEN, DST, SIID, payload, and signature across all six PyNaCl canonical signed-mode vectors, plus omitted DST/payload/SIID/DST_LEN, reordered DST/SIID, legacy unprefixed transcripts, and MIC-included transcripts. Relay semantics confirmed against spec/06-security.md §8.4: no current link-frame field is mutated under an unchanged signature; relay changes occur after verify, then a new destination/replay tuple/frame is signed for the next hop. Validation: C UBSan interop ctest 1/1 and direct 6/6 all-field checks; C Schnorr regression ctest 1/1; Python frame/Schnorr parity 145 passed, 10 skipped; Rust schnorr48_vectors 2/2 and shared_vectors 6/6. git diff --check clean. Production frame/crypto files untouched by this leaf.
